channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: Fanatics teams up with OpenAI for new AI-powered shopping suggestion feature
item.description: Fanatics is using a new 'Shop the Look' feature powered by OpenAI Codex to help shoppers navigate its more than 1.5 million sports merchandise items.

item.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
item.description: South Korea is leaning toward a fourth delay of its crypto gains tax, pushing it from January 2027 to 2029.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
item.description: Anthropic's Monday IPO filing shows revenue above $16 billion for the first half of 2026, up from about $4.5 billion in 2025.

item.title: Netanyahu touts Trump endorsement on eve of vote, suggests they may restart war on Iran
item.description: Netanyahu touted Trump's endorsement before Israel's election, suggesting the two could restart their war against Iran if he wins.

item.title: Roux de Bezieux set to lead French Alps 2030 committee, source says
item.description: PARIS, Oct 26 : Geoffroy Roux de Bezieux is expected to be named president of the organising committee for the 2030 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games (OCOG) in the French…

item.title: New iPad mini vs previous model: Here’s everything new
item.description: The new iPad mini is thinner at 5.4mm versus 6.3mm, has 24% smaller bezels, an 8.5-inch OLED display, and weighs 255 grams.

item.title: Leaked 256-core Zen 6c EPYC CPU destroys Zen 5 in early single-threaded benchmarks hints at 24% IPC gain
item.description: Leaked early benchmarks of a 256-core Zen 6c EPYC chip hint at a possible IPC gain over Zen 5, though this is not yet clear.

item.title: Anthropic flags ‘existential risks’ in long-awaited IPO filing
item.description: Anthropic PBC filed for an IPO, warning its technology carried existential risks, and expects to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT.

item.title: Stolen AI Reasoning Could Help China Build Cheaper Rivals
item.description: OpenAI, Grok, Claude and Gemini don’t simply help us, they have also been tricked into helping China produce cheap rivals.

item.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
item.description: Immunefi CEO Mitchell Amador warned that websites, especially smaller ones slow to adopt emergency upgrades, could stay compromised for weeks after the PHP vulnerability.

item.title: US stocks gain as investors parse Anthropic IPO filing
item.description: US stocks gained on Monday as investors digested Anthropic's IPO filing, while Brent crude fell 0.84% to US$116 a barrel.

item.title: Ukraine warns hackers are exploiting Chinese-made Dahua surveillance cameras
item.description: CERT-UA says hackers compromised Dahua internet-connected cameras and recorders, changed settings and created unauthorized accounts, apparently exploiting the Easy4IP cloud feature.

item.title: IPO filing reveals Anthropic's ambitions: AI expected to solve problems that previous generations could not
item.description: Anthropic's S-1 filing for a Nasdaq listing discloses first-half revenue of $16.3 billion and a net loss of $80.7 billion.

item.title: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers…
item.description: danmu_api before 1.21.7 has an authentication bypass (CVSS 9.3) letting unauthenticated attackers change environment settings when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset.

item.title: MacCMS v10 before 2026.1000.4054 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
item.description: MacCMS v10 before 2026.1000.4054 has an authentication bypass (CVSS 9.3) letting unauthenticated attackers reset any member's password by abusing a missing comparison in check_msg().

item.title: Brazil stocks, real tumble as Lula’s re-election ends bullish run
item.description: Brazilian stocks and the real currency slumped after President Lula da Silva's re-election, with trading halted after the Ibovespa fell 10%.

item.title: Matiks raises $10M to expand its math and puzzle gaming platform
item.description: India-based Matiks raised $10 million in pre-Series A funding led by General Catalyst, as its math and puzzle app grew to over 300,000 daily users.

item.title: Apple Brings TechWoven to iPad With All-New $79 iPad Mini Smart Folio
item.description: Apple's new $79 iPad mini Smart Folio uses TechWoven woven fabric in place of polyurethane and costs $20 more than the previous model.

item.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: This2Shell, That2Shell, Everything's an RCE? Rogue AI, Supply Chain Chaos and More
item.description: A weekly recap covering critical code-execution bugs, including PHP2Shell, a supply-chain attack via a leaked key, and AI agents tricked into harmful actions.

item.title: US stocks: Wall Street opens higher as Anthropic’s IPO filing sharpens AI focus
item.description: All three major US indices opened higher on Monday as investors focused on Anthropic's IPO filing.

item.title: When an AI Agent Is the Incident, the Identity Record Is the Evidence
item.description: Argues identity records showing whose credentials an AI agent used are key evidence after runaway-agent incidents, which a new NIST, CISA and NSA guide addresses.

item.title: Significant AI enhancements to smart glasses 'Even G2': 'Hints' shown after listening to conversations are now more accurate
item.description: Even Realities has released a major firmware update for its Even G2 smart glasses, strengthening AI features, including more accurate conversation hints.

item.title: 10 Software Security Practices Built for the Next 250 Years
item.description: An opinion piece lists 10 software security practices, such as making security part of system architecture, for Cybersecurity Awareness Month's 'Securing the Next 250' theme.

item.title: Nine companies from Singapore and the region bag top honours at 2026 Emerging Enterprise Awards
item.description: Nine companies from Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Indonesia won top honours at the 2026 Emerging Enterprise Awards, run by The Business Times and OCBC.

item.title: Anthropic opens books on AI’s explosive growth and staggering costs
item.description: Anthropic unveiled its US IPO filing on Oct 26, reporting a first-half 2026 net loss of US$80.7 billion and revenue of about US$16.3 billion.

item.title: Natural gas to stay for the long haul beyond 2050: Singapore International Energy Week panellists
item.description: Panellists at Singapore International Energy Week say natural gas will remain significant beyond 2050, for power generation, grid stability and decarbonisation.

item.title: Anthropic files to go public
item.description: Anthropic filed its Form S-1 with the SEC to list on Nasdaq as 'ANT'. Share count and price are not yet set, though the IPO could value the company at around $2 trillion, with a debut expected in mid-November. Why it matters: A possible roughly $2 trillion listing is a major markets event for AI and startup watchers.

item.title: How Black-Box Distillation Works
item.description: Explains black-box distillation, where a weaker model learns from a closed model's outputs, and how adversarial distillation from US models may have occurred.

item.title: Anthropic Publicly Files S-1 for Its Planned IPO
item.description: Anthropic publicly filed a preliminary IPO prospectus covering its first-half business, governance, and more than 90 pages of risk factors.

item.title: Samsung reportedly slashes production plans for millions of Galaxy phones
item.description: As RAMageddon rages on, brands are making tough choices including price hikes and refocused lineups.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing lays out a plan to ‘revolutionize every area of human endeavor’ with AI
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing outlines a mission to 'revolutionize every area of human endeavor' with AI and warns its corporate behavior may diverge from profit maximization.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
item.description: Anthropic's US IPO paperwork, unveiled Monday, shows most of its revenue comes from businesses paying per use for its models.

item.title: PHP2Shell Exploitation Moves From Probes to Working Shells
item.description: Attackers have run shell commands on honeypots via the PHP2Shell flaws, and Siemens, Schneider Electric and ABB say some of their products are affected.

item.title: Goldman Sachs to Lead Anthropic IPO
item.description: Anthropic filed an S-1 with the U.S. SEC to list Class A shares on Nasdaq under the ticker 'ANT'. Goldman Sachs has the lead left role; offering size, price range and listing date are not yet announced. Why it matters: A planned public listing of an AI startup is a notable markets event for readers following AI and startups.

item.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
item.description: Anthropic's S-1 shows first-half 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion and a net loss of $80.7 billion, with pricing aimed for mid-November.

item.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
item.description: Bernstein expects Robinhood's prediction markets to generate up to $1.7 billion by 2028, surpassing its projected $1.6 billion crypto revenue that year.

item.title: Apple unveils a redesigned iPad mini with an 8.5-inch OLED display, an A20 Pro, 24% thinner bezels, and a nano-texture finish option, for $699+ from November 6
item.description: Apple unveiled a redesigned iPad mini with an 8.5-inch OLED display, A20 Pro, 24% thinner bezels, and a nano-texture option, available from November 6.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO filing shows explosive growth, risks and staggering costs
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing shows revenue grew 1,368% in the three months ended June 30 from a year earlier, with a first-half 2026 net loss widening sharply to $80.7 billion. The company warned that revenue growth could decline over time. Why it matters: Rapid AI revenue growth alongside large losses is a useful data point for investors tracking AI and startup valuations.

item.title: Anthropic's co-founders say they "believe that AI is one of the most consequential technologies in human history", detail its scientific potential, and more
item.description: We believe that Al is one of the most consequential technologies in human history.

item.title: S'pore woman, 35, admits to helping dispose of Megan Khung's body & not stopping abuse by mother & boyfriend
item.description: Nouvelle Chua Roushi, 35, pleaded guilty to helping dispose of four-year-old Megan Khung's body and to conspiracy to commit child abuse.

item.description: A Brown University senior, Cunyan Ma, has built a free interactive map linking technology companies and intermediaries to data workers around the world.

item.title: Qiyuan Robotics rolls off 5,000th unit; physical AI moves toward home consumer scenarios
item.description: Qiyuan Robotics rolled off its 5,000th personal robot on October 25, within a month of starting production.

item.title: Apple updates the iPad Mini with a larger OLED display
item.description: Apple announced a new iPad mini with an 8.5-inch OLED display, starting at $699 for the Wi-Fi-only model and $849 for Wi-Fi and cellular. At 5.4mm thick, it is thinner and lighter than its predecessor. Why it matters: Touches AI models, covered by 8 outlets.

item.title: Making Multi-Color 3D Printing Workflow More Practical With Creality’s K3
item.description: Creality's K3, a flagship 3D printer, is available for pre-order at $849 in the US, using a four-nozzle KliTek system for multi-color printing.

item.title: Your AI is still burning tokens, while the industry's first Pro Agent is already making money
item.description: At the TGC 2026 conference, Chinese AI company 钛动科技 launched Navos Pro, billed as the industry's first Pro Agent, to help enterprises make money.

item.description: Meta plans to raise up to $95 billion in equity, its largest-ever fundraising, to fund its AI infrastructure expansion.

item.description: Per Crunchbase data, California startups have raised a record $385 billion so far in 2026, over three-fourths of all US startup funding.

item.title: SAF revamps active infantry battalions with drone suite, real-time battle map

item.title: Samajwadi Party circulated a derogatory AI video targeting Yogi Adityanath.
item.description: Samajwadi Party circulated a derogatory AI video targeting Yogi Adityanath, and Maharashtra Police filed an FIR against the poster of an Akhilesh Yadav reel.

item.description: SpaceX signed a roughly $40 billion equipment-finance lease with Apollo Global Management to fund purchases of Nvidia GPUs for its AI efforts.

item.title: GitHub is free. So what stops me from dumping 1000GB in a repo and calling it my cloud storage?
item.description: A user asks what stops them from storing 1000GB in a GitHub repo as free cloud storage, and why anyone pays for Google Drive. Why it matters: Relevant to readers following GitHub; the post asks a question without giving an answer.

item.title: JetBrains/thinkrail: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You…
item.description: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE built around the pi coding agent, isolating agent work in separate git-worktree workspaces with living specs and reusable skills. It has 2,336 GitHub stars, 1,156 of them today. Why it matters: JetBrains-published tool for running AI coding agents in parallel, each in its own git workspace.

item.title: Jamus Lim responds to PM Wong's criticisms that WP 'shifts with the political winds', Petir responds in turn
item.description: WP MP Jamus Lim called PM Wong's criticism of the party a 'double standard'; PAP's Petir then criticised Lim.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: The Model and Safety Cards
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon's model and safety cards show it is much stronger than Gemini Flash 3.8 and raises no major danger alarms.

item.title: 953 Online Stores Infected in Long-Lasting Malware Campaign
